purpose: Capture requirement statements derived from the B1 auxiliary-domain inventory and MCU control-platform pretrade without inventing U1 numeric values or selecting an architecture.

requirements.requirement_statement: The U1 auxiliary-power architecture shall have a traceable steady-state current budget for every generated rail and operating mode.
requirements.rationale: B1 converter source ratings do not prove actual system load.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Every rail load is itemized, summed and measured at representative modes with documented margin.

requirements.requirement_statement: The U1 auxiliary-power architecture shall bound startup, inrush and short-duration transient demand for each rail and external auxiliary load.
requirements.rationale: B1 explicitly leaves fan inrush and several external loads unmeasured.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Worst credible startup/transient demand is below converter current-limit/thermal boundaries with margin.

requirements.requirement_statement: Gate-drive auxiliary power shall be budgeted from the selected MOSFET gate charge, driven-device count, gate voltage, PWM frequency and switching pattern rather than copied from B1.
requirements.rationale: Gate-drive dynamic demand changes with semiconductor/PWM architecture.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Calculated and measured gate-drive demand fits the selected auxiliary source with stated thermal/current margin.

requirements.requirement_statement: External fan, Hall-sensor and exported interface power loads shall be explicit bounded interface contracts rather than implicit board loads.
requirements.rationale: B1 exposes external +12 V and +5 V loads whose maximum demand is not closed.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Each external load has voltage/current/inrush bounds and protection behavior in the interface specification.

requirements.requirement_statement: Auxiliary rail sequencing shall prevent unintended back-power of an unpowered control or analog domain in every supported power state.
requirements.rationale: B1 has a proven rail-clamp back-power path and U1 sensing may move the path unless sequencing is controlled.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: No rail or MCU pin exceeds its allowed unpowered bias/current in all documented sequencing states.

requirements.requirement_statement: MCU selection shall be based on the frozen PWM/ADC/control workload and measured or source-bounded timing margin, not nominal CPU frequency alone.
requirements.rationale: STM32G474 and TMS320F280041C expose different control/analog architectures and clock frequency is not a normalized FOC benchmark.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Selected MCU meets worst-case control-loop execution and interrupt/DMA schedule margin at frozen PWM rate.

requirements.requirement_statement: The selected MCU shall support deterministic PWM-synchronous three-shunt current acquisition in valid switching windows.
requirements.rationale: Three-shunt reconstruction depends on trigger and acquisition scheduling, not ADC count alone.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: ADC triggers, sample windows and PWM updates satisfy the frozen timing contract across commanded duty range.

requirements.requirement_statement: Exact MCU package pin allocation shall close all required PWM, ADC, CAN, gate-driver, temperature and service/debug functions before U1 schematic freeze.
requirements.rationale: Family-level peripheral availability does not guarantee package-level simultaneous pin feasibility.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Zero unresolved required pin conflicts in the selected orderable package.

requirements.requirement_statement: A hardware-capable fault path shall force PWM to a defined safe state independently of normal motor-control software execution.
requirements.rationale: Both candidate platforms expose hardware trip resources, but the final path and latency are not yet selected or measured.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Fault-to-PWM-inhibit response meets the frozen semiconductor/protection safe-action requirement.

requirements.requirement_statement: The U1 CAN or CAN-FD physical/controller architecture shall be selected from the frozen flight-controller protocol and traffic requirements rather than inherited from the B1 Classic-CAN transceiver.
requirements.rationale: B1 uses SN65HVD230 Classic CAN while STM32G474 exposes FDCAN capability; the vehicle protocol remains open.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Controller/transceiver/protocol/bit-rate/timeout requirements are mutually compatible and verified under representative traffic.

anti_hallucination_rule: All value_or_range fields remain null until their parent requirements are frozen or evidenced. These records define what must be closed; they do not freeze values or select STM32, C2000, LM5164, LTC3639, LTC7801, fan, Hall sensor, or CAN transceiver.
